name: Delonghi PrimaDonna Exclusive ESAM6900 Espresso Machine (Certified Refurbished)
description: There are undeniably classic pairings that stand the test of time (pass the milk and cookies, please!) and Delonghi has taken this one step further by combining a duo so perfect, it rivals the most classic of romances. Step aside Romeo and Juliet, coffee and chocolate are here to stay! The Delonghi Primadonna Exlusive Certified Refurbished machine not only creates delicious coffee and milk based drinks with the touch of a button, but it also has an exclusive carafe specially designed to heat and mix chocolatey drinks. Pair that with the large LCD screen and almost infinite programmability options, the possibilities become endless…and delicious! Features & Functionality of the Delonghi PrimaDonna Exclusive ESAM6900 Espresso Machine (Certified Refurbished) Color LCD Screen - The Exclusive features a large, vibrant colored LCD screen where the programming happens and alerts warn you when something is awry. Door ajar! True One-Touch - With the stainless steel milk carafe attached, this machine is a true one-touch. Easily select a pre-programmed drink from the chocolate, caffelatte, cappuccino, latte macchiato or long coffee button. Cup Warmer - Nobody likes a cold cup of joe! Set your cups on the warming shelf prior to brewing. Find Your Grind - Dial in your ideal grind with the grind adjustment knob located in the bean hopper, or use the bypass doser to enjoy your favorite pre-ground blend. Hot Water Spout - Removable hot water spout doubles as a manual steam wand for controlled frothing. Removable Water Tank - The 48 ounce water tank is conveniently removable for easy filling and cleaning. Programmable Coffee Strength - Choose from six different coffee strength options: pre-ground, extra mild, mild, standard, strong and extra-strong. Stainless Steel Milk Carafe - Attach the stainless steel thermal milk carafe and choose from three automatic frothing options.
